discription: A short, percussive sound generated by a filtered white noise burst with a quick envelope, resembling a wood block or a metallic hit.
code: { arg out=0, freq=880, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.05; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.001, 0.05, 0.0, 0.1, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); sig = BPF.ar(WhiteNoise.ar(0.5), freq, rq) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
